name: Tourist Visa

requirements.blocker_text: As of 1 November 2026, Montenegro fully aligned its visa policy with the EU: nationals of Belarus, China, Russia, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye -- previously visa-exempt or visa-on-arrival -- now require a visa obtained in advance through a Montenegrin diplomatic/consular mission or a VFS Visa Application Centre (operating in India, Bangladesh, Kyrgyzstan, Azerbaijan, Turkiye, the UAE, and Russia, with more centres planned). An electronic visa system was under development at time of writing but not yet operational.
requirements.fix_path: Apply via a Montenegrin embassy/consulate or a VFS Visa Application Centre before travel, if a national of a newly-visa-required country.

outcome.duration_length: not specified precisely in the source reviewed

sources.title: Government of Montenegro (gov.me) -- official announcement of full EU visa-policy alignment effective 1 November 2026, naming Belarus, China, Russia, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye as newly visa-required, and listing VFS Visa Application Centre locations

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Montenegro). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct government sourcing, tier 1, and a genuinely LIVE and recent policy change (effective the same month as this build). GAP, DISCLOSED NOT INVENTED: the source addresses only the newly-restricted nationalities, not the full visa-exempt list or standard tourist-visa duration/documents for already-visa-exempt nationalities (most of Europe, the Americas, and others) -- worth a dedicated follow-up. As an EU-candidate country pursuing EU accession, Montenegro's visa policy is actively converging with the EU's own list, so this route should be re-verified periodically rather than treated as settled.
